days.title: High Peaks and Glaciers of the Ortles Group
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: passo dello Stelvio
stops.detail: The main ridge starts at the Stelvio Pass (2,758 m), the second highest drivable pass in Europe connecting Bormio to Trafoi, and rises into numerous peaks above 3,500 m, such as Punta Thurwieser (3,652 m), Gran Zebrù (3,857 m), and Cevedale (3,769 m), culminating with the peak of Ortles at 3,905 m.

stops.name: Ortles
stops.detail: Almost all the peaks of the Ortles Alps are included in the park.

stops.name: ghiacciaio dei Forni
stops.detail: In addition to numerous streams along the respective valleys, several important glaciers are present in the territory, the most important of which is the Forni glacier, the largest Italian alpine valley glacier, located on the Lombard side.

days.title: Forests and Wildlife Areas of Trentino
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: val di Rabbi
stops.detail: The most widespread species is certainly the Norway spruce (Picea abies), associated with a few isolated groups of silver fir (Abies alba), the latter present mainly in Val di Rabbi, the Trentino area of the Park.

stops.name: Val di Peio
stops.detail: These tree formations climb the slopes, thinning out towards the upper limit to slowly give way to the larch (Larix decidua) and the stone pine (Pinus cembra), mainly widespread in Val di Peio.
